literal_meaning: পেটের দায় বা জ্বালা (stomach's responsibility or burning)
figurative_meaning_en: worry about sustenance, lack of food, pangs of hunger
example_sentences_in_bangla: পেটের দায়ে সে অনেক কঠিন কাজ করে।
অন্নাভাবের কারণে পেটের জ্বালায় তার মন খারাপ হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to the stomach's need, he does many hard jobs.
Because of lack of food, the burning in his stomach has made him upset.
note: This idiom reflects the struggles of food scarcity in everyday Bengali life, often linked to rural or working-class experiences.
